general.notes: Copper (Grey SFP) module; transmission media Electrical (1x RJ45). Typical reach 100m using CAT5e cable or better (footnote 1). Operating temperature 0°C to +70°C for SO-SFP-1000Base-T (-T); -40°C to +85°C for SO-SFP-1000Base-T-I (-T-I). Power consumption stated as < 1.2W. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Sync on line side preferred slave (footnote 2). Auto-negotiation towards host. Rx LOS: No. Safety/regulatory: TUV/UL/FDA; RoHS compliance.
general.suggestions: Schema could add copper-specific fields (cable category CAT5/CAT5e, reach in meters) and support multiple operating-temperature SKUs without merging min/max across variants.
